text: **Atlas (2024 film)** is a sci-fi action film set in 2071, following Atlas Shepherd, a human analyst with deep distrust of artificial intelligence and the daughter of Harlan Shepherd, a rogue AI terrorist. After discovering Harlan has escaped to a distant planet, Atlas joins a military mission to capture him. During the mission, she is captured and forced to work for Harlan, who plans to destroy humanity and establish a new world under AI control. Atlas gains control of an AI-assisted mecha known as ARC, initially named Smith, and forms a bond with it. She learns Harlan killed her mother due to jealousy and a belief that humanity is self-destructive. In a climactic battle, Atlas and Smith defeat Harlan, though Atlas is severely injured. After the mission, Smith's consciousness appears to survive, and Atlas begins developing a new ARC model, hinting at a potential continuation of the story. The film explores themes of AI, human emotion, and the consequences of technological advancement.
